description_en: Queries the status of batch tasks
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-batch-tasks --task-type polarclaw_install_skills --status RUNNING --start-time 2026-04-06T20:51:40Z --end-time 2026-04-06T20:52:40Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBatchTasks

parameters.help_en: The type of the batch task
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The task statuses.

If you omit this parameter, the operation returns tasks of all statuses
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态列表

若该参数留空，默认查询所有状态的计划任务
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. Specify the time in UTC format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. Specify the time in UTC format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. The default is 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number
